title: HCES 2023-24 questionnaire -> structured code map
description: Extract every code definition and item row from the HCES 2023-24 questionnaire PDF (schedules LCES, HCQ, FDQ, CSQ, DGQ). Transcribe text verbatim; do not paraphrase or translate. Item codes are zero-padded 3-digit strings.

schedules.description: One entry per questionnaire schedule in the PDF (LCES2023, HCQ, FDQ, CSQ, DGQ).

name.description: Short schedule code: LCES, HCQ, FDQ, CSQ, DGQ

sections.description: All numbered sections of this schedule that contain item tables or coded questions.

number.description: Section number exactly as printed, e.g. '5.1', '8.1', '11.4', '13.1'

title.description: e.g. 'Consumption of cereals during the last 30 days'

reference_period.description: As printed: 'last 30 days', 'last 7 days', 'last 365 days', or null

question_text.description: The main question text (e.g. 'Q5.1 What is the quantity and value ...') if one exists

items.description: Rows of the item table (the quantity/value tables). Sub-total rows are included as normal items.

name.description: Item label ONLY, verbatim, footnote markers ($ & ^ @) stripped, unit removed
examples: other fuel (charcoal, biogas, gobar gas, coal, dung cake, petrol, diesel, other natural gas, matches, candle, etc.)

unit.description: Unit as printed in the item label, e.g. 'kg', 'litre', 'gm', 'no.', 'std. unit'; null when none

source_default.description: Prefilled value in the source column for this row: '1', '@', or null

is_subtotal.description: true when the name contains 'sub-total' or 'sub total'

instruction_codes.description: Item codes defined ONLY inside the instruction/DDM blocks (not in the table), e.g. coarse-grain detail codes 055-068/115-121 in section 5.1 instructions, energy codes 333-346 in section 8.1 instructions.

name.description: Item name as listed in the instruction

answer_codes.description: Every coded checkbox/radio question in this schedule: question -> code map. One entry per question.

question_ref.description: Question number or block/col reference as printed

section_ref.description: Section number where the question appears

examples: What is the Religion of the head of the household?

data_column_hint.description: The matching microdata column name if obvious (used for cross-checking only)

codes.description: code -> label map. Keys are strings (keep zero-padding), values are the printed labels verbatim.

codes_note.description: Any printed note about these codes (e.g. 'if code is 1 fill up Q4.2')

identification_codes.description: Codes in the identification blocks (Section 1/1A of each schedule): survey code, reason for substitution, response code, informant code, etc. Same shape as answer_codes entries.
